name: Home and Community
description: Provides assistance with maintaining cleanliness in the house, including housekeeping tasks like sweeping, dishes, meal prep, cleaning, laundry, errands, and shopping.

name: Structured Family Care
description: A caregiver who lives at the same address as the client may be eligible. Support may include activities of daily living (ADLs) and Home and Community tasks.

name: Attendant Care
description: Provides hands-on, hourly assistance with daily activities like bathing, dressing, and mobility. Under updated rules, Legally Responsible Individuals (LRIs), such as spouses or parents of minors, generally cannot be paid as attendant care providers.
